questions.questionText: Solve 2x² − 7x + 3 = 0 by factorisation.

questions.questionText: In a right-angled triangle, an acute angle θ has opposite side 5 cm and hypotenuse 13 cm. Find sin θ and cos θ.

questions.answerText: Angle at centre=2×48°=96°. The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference standing on the same arc.
